text: SELECT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.mesh_heading, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary JOIN drug_indication ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE (drug_indication.mesh_heading = 'Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus' OR drug_indication.mesh_heading = 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2') AND molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4
